mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where RSAFS MoM growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM growth is below -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy with a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market weakness
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% and PAYEMS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST MoM growth exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows below 1% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) declines, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth < 1% and INDPRO MoM growth < 0%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth is below 1% and INDPRO MoM growth is negative.
